blocks.title: Probability
blocks.text: Probability is the study of how likely an event is to happen. It helps predict outcomes from what we know: probability = favourable outcomes / total outcomes.

Flipping a coin has two equally likely outcomes, heads or tails, so the probability of heads is 1/2, or 50%, and of tails also 50%. Probability is used in weather prediction, business decisions and even cricket. Statistics helps us understand patterns for better decisions in fields from healthcare to marketing (Tip), and is used every day, for example in weather forecasts and sports analysis (Did You Know).
